title: When All Rollouts Fail: Policy-Compatible Joint Decoding for Hard-Problem Reasoning
title_zh: 当所有 rollout 都失败时：面向难题推理的策略兼容联合解码

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) derives its learning signal from binary rewards via on-policy exploration and becomes a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning of large language models. Yet it faces a learning cliff on problems beyond model’s current ability: when every rollout fails, the samples reveal nothing about a correct solution, and group-relative estimators (e.g., GRPO, RLOO) collapse the update to zero advantage. Expert trajectories offer a remedy, but they are incompatible with the current policy and often lie in the student’s low-probability regions, so the surviving updates demand large parameter shifts and decay into surface-level imitation rather than transferable reasoning. We argue that a useful learning signal on hard problems must be both verifiably correct and sufficiently compatible with the current policy. We propose Policy-Compatible Reinforcement Learning ( PICO ), which performs distribution-constrained joint decoding: expert data guides decoding at the token level while preserving the student’s relative token probabilities, and a dynamic top-k mechanism confines the sampling distribution under a finite divergence budget, yielding trajectories that are verified and policy-compatible by construction. These trajectories are optimized jointly with on-policy rollouts under a mixed-behavior objective that mitigates their distribution mismatch via importance sampling. Experiments across reasoning diverse datasets and agentic benchmarks demonstrate that PICO consistently outperforms standard RLVR and prior off-policy baselines.

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs) ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Jaech et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2025 ) , demonstrating strong effectiveness in enhancing reasoning capabilities across domains such as mathematics, coding, and agentic tasks ( Dong et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . RLVR enables LLMs to learn directly from verifiable reward feedback on trajectories generated through on-policy exploration, yielding substantial and generalizable performance gains ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) . However, this reliance on successful exploration creates a learning cliff on challenging problems beyond the model’s current capabilities: when all sampled rollouts fail, the policy receives no positive reward signal ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Yue et al., 2025 ) . This issue is particularly acute for methods based on group-relative advantage estimation (e.g., GRPO) ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) , as all-zero-reward groups cause the estimated advantages to collapse to zero, leaving no informative learning signal to drive futher improvement on these problems.
paragraphs.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为对大语言模型（LLM）进行后训练的重要范式（Guo et al., 2025；Jaech et al., 2024；Team et al., 2025），在提升数学、编程和智能体任务等领域的推理能力方面展现出显著成效（Dong et al., 2026a；Zhang et al., 2025a）。 RLVR 使 LLM 能够直接从对通过策略内探索生成的轨迹所给出的可验证奖励反馈中学习，从而获得显著且可泛化的性能提升（Zhu et al., 2025；Shenfeld et al., 2026）。 然而，这种对成功探索的依赖在超出模型当前能力的困难问题上造成了学习断崖：当所有采样得到的 rollout 都失败时，策略无法获得任何正向奖励信号（Agrawal et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2025b；Yue et al., 2025）。 这一问题对于基于组相对优势估计的方法（例如 GRPO）尤为严重（Yu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026c），因为全零奖励的组会使估计的优势坍缩为零，导致没有有效的学习信号来推动模型在这些问题上进一步改进。

paragraphs.en: A natural remedy is to leverage expert data, which offer a promising way to overcome this exploration bottleneck and are increasingly used to supplement online RL training. Typically generated by human experts or stronger models, expert trajectories expose the student to high-quality reasoning paths and provide informative learning signals. Yet these trajectories are not necessarily compatible with the current policy and often fall within low-probability regions under its distribution. Existing methods utilize such trajectories in three main ways. Some use them as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) targets alongside RL training ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . When these trajectories lie in low-probability regions under the current policy, directly fitting them can induce excessive policy drift and result in surface-level imitation rather than transferable reasoning ( Yan et al., 2025 ) . Other approaches incorporate expert trajectories into rollout groups as off-policy samples to recover informative learning signals ( Yan et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026b ) . The distributional mismatch between these off-policy trajectories and on-policy rollouts can distort the resulting learning signals and destabilize optimization ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Setlur et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) . A further line of work ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026d ) leverages expert trajectories indirectly, using them to construct prefixes or hints that guide subsequent exploration and generation. Although the resulting continuations are generated by the current policy, they are conditioned on intermediate states that the policy may not be able to reach on its own from the original prompt ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . This creates privileged-context dependence: once the guidance is removed, the model may struggle to reproduce the full reasoning process. Collectively, these limitations reveal a fundamental trade-off: an effective learning signal on challenging problems must come from trajectories that are both verifiably correct and sufficiently compatible with the current student policy. Although expert data can provide verifiably correct trajectories, naively incorporating them may sacrifice policy compatibility by pulling the policy toward behaviors that lie far outside its current distribution, ultimately undermining stable and effective policy improvement.

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we propose Policy-Compatible Reinforcement Learning ( PICO ), which uses distribution-constrained joint decoding to recover positive learning signals from off-policy trajectories while explicitly controlling the induced distribution shift. Specifically, joint decoding constructs the next-token candidate set by intersecting high-probability tokens predicted by a teacher conditioned on expert data with those predicted by the student, thereby restricting sampling to candidates favored by both models. In this way, the teacher provides token-level guidance to improve rollout accuracy, while sampling according to the student’s relative probabilities preserves its own preferences. To further constrain the joint sampling distribution within a finite divergence budget, we introduce a dynamic top- k k mechanism that adaptively adjusts the teacher’s candidate set. Finally, the resulting trajectories verified for correctness are optimized alongside on-policy rollouts through a mixed-behavior objective.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出策略兼容强化学习（PICO），它利用分布约束的联合解码从离策略轨迹中恢复正向学习信号，同时显式控制由此引起的分布偏移。 具体而言，联合解码通过将基于专家数据条件的教师所预测的高概率令牌与学生所预测的令牌取交集来构建下一令牌候选集，从而将采样限制在两个模型都偏好的候选上。 通过这种方式，教师提供令牌级指导以提升轨迹生成的准确性，而按学生的相对概率进行采样则保留了学生自身的偏好。 为了进一步将联合采样分布约束在有限的散度预算之内，我们引入了一种动态 top-k 机制，自适应地调整教师的候选集。 最后，经验证正确的所得轨迹通过与在策略轨迹共同优化的混合行为目标进行训练。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , PICO activates joint decoding only for all-failure groups, preserving standard on-policy optimization whenever student exploration already yields positive rewards. Figure 4 further shows that joint decoding recovers verified, positive-reward trajectories in up to 80% of all-failure groups, thereby restoring informative learning signals where standard on-policy sampling yields none. Extensive experiments across mathematics and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PICO consistently outperforms standard RLVR and existing expert-guided baselines. Further evaluations on agentic tasks establish its generalizability beyond conventional reasoning settings. paragraphs.en: In this section, we detail the design and implementation of PICO . As illustrated in Figure 1 and Algorithm 1 , the framework consists of two components: distribution-constrained joint decoding and mixed-behavior policy optimization. First, distribution-constrained joint decoding combines the token-level preferences of the teacher and student to generate rollouts, with a dynamic top- k k mechanism adaptively balancing teacher guidance and distribution shift. Second, mixed-behavior policy optimization learns from the resulting trajectories using importance-sampling (IS) ratios to account for the mismatch between the joint-decoding policy and the student policy.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们详细介绍 PICO 的设计与实现。 如图 1 和算法 1 所示，该框架由两个部分组成：分布约束联合解码和混合行为策略优化。 首先，分布约束联合解码结合教师与智能体的 token 级偏好来生成 rollout，并通过动态 top- k k 机制自适应地平衡教师指导与分布偏移。 其次，混合行为策略优化利用重要性采样（IS）比率从产生的轨迹中学习，以处理联合解码策略与智能体策略之间的不匹配。

paragraphs.en: Models and Datasets. In our main experiments, we consider three student policies with different model scales and instruction-tuning configurations: Qwen3-4B-Base, Qwen3-8B-Base, and Qwen3-4B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . We use Qwen3-4B-Instruct specifically for the agentic-task experiments. Across all settings, Qwen3-4B-Instruct, conditioned on expert solutions, serves as the teacher model. For mathematical and general reasoning tasks, we use DAPO-Math-17K ( Yu et al., 2026 ) as the training set, which contains a large collection of challenging problems paired with high-quality expert demonstrations. For agentic tasks, we conduct experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, two widely used interactive reasoning benchmarks.

Specifically, LUFFY ( Yan et al., 2025 ) combines on-policy rollouts with off-policy demonstrations through mixed-policy GRPO and regularized policy shaping; Prefix-RFT ( Huang et al., 2026 ) constructs hybrid trajectories by pairing prefixes sampled from expert demonstrations with policy-generated continuations; and ReLIFT ( Ma et al., 2026 ) interleaves reinforcement learning with targeted online supervised fine-tuning on challenging problems. We additionally compare with RLRT ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , a self-distillation method that uses reversed teacher signals to emphasize student-preferred tokens in verified successful trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们将 PICO 与 GRPO 以及三种具有代表性的离策略方法进行比较，同时还包括一个自蒸馏基线。 具体而言，LUFFY（Yan et al., 2025）通过混合策略 GRPO 和正则化策略塑形，将在线策略的采样与离策略的示范结合起来；Prefix-RFT（Huang et al., 2026）通过将专家示范中采样得到的前缀与策略生成的后续部分配对来构建混合轨迹；而 ReLIFT（Ma et al., 2026）则将强化学习与针对具有挑战性问题的定向在线监督微调交替进行。 我们还与 RLRT（Kim et al., 2026）进行了比较，这是一种自蒸馏方法，它利用反向教师信号在经过验证的成功轨迹中强调学生偏好的词元。

paragraphs.en: Training Details. For a fair comparison, we use the same training configuration for all RL methods. We remove the KL regularization term by setting β = 0 \beta=0 and omit standard-deviation normalization in the advantage computation to avoid implicitly reweighting problems according to their within-group reward variance. We fix the total rollout group size at 8 for every query. For PICO and all off-policy baselines, each mixed group consists of 7 on-policy trajectories and 1 off-policy trajectory. We use a global training batch size of 128, a PPO mini-batch size of 64, and a maximum response length of 20,480 20{,}480 tokens. Following DAPO, we adopt asymmetric clipping with ϵ high = 0.28 \epsilon_{\mathrm{high}}=0.28 and ϵ low = 0.20 \epsilon_{\mathrm{low}}=0.20 . The complete training configuration is provided in Appendix C.1 .

paragraphs.en: Evaluations. Following prior work, we evaluate primarily on four widely used and challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks: AIME 2025, AIME 2026, HMMT 2026, and MATH-500. During evaluation, we set the sampling temperature to 0.6 0.6 and the maximum response length to 20,480 20{,}480 tokens. To reduce the effect of sampling variance, we independently sample 16 responses for each problem and report the average accuracy across these samples (avg@16). To assess out-of-distribution generalization beyond the mathematics-focused training domain, we additionally evaluate on GPQA-Diamond and Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE). Appendix C.2 provides additional information about the evaluation benchmarks.

paragraphs.en: Performance Comparison. As shown in Table 1 , PICO consistently achieves the strongest overall performance across both model scales. It improves the average score over GRPO by 4.1 4.1 percentage points with Qwen3-4B-Base and by 3.6 3.6 points with Qwen3-8B-Base, while outperforming the strongest competing method by 2.2 2.2 and 1.8 1.8 points, respectively. The gains are particularly pronounced on challenging benchmarks such as AIME26 and HMMT26, supporting our claim that PICO enables effective learning from difficult problems that frequently produce all-incorrect rollout groups. Moreover, the consistent improvements on GPQA-Diamond and HLE demonstrate that the learned reasoning capability generalizes beyond the mathematics-focused training distribution. Since the teacher is unavailable during evaluation, these gains reflect improvements internalized by the student rather than reliance on privileged guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 性能比较。 如表 1 所示，PICO 在两种模型规模下均持续取得最强的整体性能。 使用 Qwen3-4B-Base 时，其平均得分比 GRPO 提高 4.1 4.1 个百分点；使用 Qwen3-8B-Base 时提高 3.6 3.6 个百分点；同时分别比最强的对比方法高出 2.2 2.2 和 1.8 1.8 个百分点。 这些提升在 AIME26 和 HMMT26 等具有挑战性的基准上尤为显著，支持了我们的主张：PICO 能够从难题中进行有效学习，而这类难题在采样时经常产生全错的 rollout 组。 此外，在 GPQA-Diamond 和 HLE 上取得的一致提升表明，所学到的推理能力能够泛化到以数学为主的训练分布之外。 由于评估时教师不可用，这些提升反映了智能体（学生模型）内化的改进，而非对特权引导的依赖。

paragraphs.en: Training Dynamics. Figure 2 shows that PICO maintains higher training rewards and consistently fewer solve-none questions than GRPO and LUFFY across both model scales. While the baselines tend to plateau after the initial stage, PICO continues to improve, indicating that failure-triggered joint decoding converts otherwise uninformative all-incorrect groups into useful learning signals. PICO also produces longer responses, which, together with the higher verified rewards and lower solve-none counts, suggests more sustained reasoning on difficult problems. Overall, these results show that PICO improves difficult-problem exploration without compromising training stability. Additional analyses in Appendix B.2 and Fig. 4 show that joint decoding consistently rescues questions for which all student self-sampled trajectories fail, thereby restoring effective learning signals for otherwise uninformative groups.
paragraphs.zh: 训练动态。 图 2 显示，在两种模型规模下，PICO 都比 GRPO 和 LUFFY 保持更高的训练奖励，并且解不出任何答案的问题数量始终更少。 虽然各基线方法在初始阶段之后往往趋于停滞，但 PICO 持续改进，这表明由失败触发的联合解码将原本不提供信息的全错组转化为有用的学习信号。 PICO 还产生更长的回复，结合更高的经验证奖励和更低的解不出任何答案的问题数量，这表明智能体在困难问题上进行了更持续的推理。 总体而言，这些结果表明 PICO 在不损害训练稳定性的情况下改善了困难问题的探索。 附录 B.2 和图 4 中的附加分析表明，联合解码始终能够挽救所有学生自采样轨迹都失败的问题，从而为原本不提供信息的组恢复有效的学习信号。

paragraphs.en: We conduct the agentic-task experiments using Qwen3-4B-Instruct as both the student policy and the teacher providing token-level guidance. As shown in Table 2 , PICO consistently outperforms all baselines across ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, achieving the highest average success rate of 74.3 % 74.3\% . Compared with GRPO, PICO improves the average performance by 6.8 6.8 percentage points, demonstrating its effectiveness in interactive environments characterized by long-horizon decision-making and sparse rewards. It also surpasses the off-policy RL method LUFFY and the prefix-guided method Prefix-RFT by 4.9 4.9 and 5.2 5.2 points on average, respectively, further validating the effectiveness of token-level joint guidance for agentic reasoning.

paragraphs.en: We analyze the contribution of each component of PICO . As shown in Table 3 , the results highlight the importance of maintaining compatibility between guided trajectories and the student policy. Directly sampling from the teacher without joint decoding introduces the largest behavior mismatch and yields the weakest ablation result, reducing the average score from 37.2 % 37.2\% to 33.8 % 33.8\% . The fixed- k k variants further reveal a trade-off between teacher guidance and student compatibility. Increasing k k retains more student-compatible tokens but weakens the selectivity of teacher guidance, potentially reducing rollout accuracy. As long as the candidate set remains sufficiently accurate, increasing k k improves learning, as evidenced by the gain from k = 5 k=5 to k = 10 k=10 . However, further increasing k k to 20 20 weakens teacher guidance and slightly reduces performance, making k = 10 k=10 the best fixed setting. In contrast, our dynamic top- k k strategy adapts the candidate set at each decoding step according to the retained student probability mass, achieving a better balance and the highest average score of 37.2 % 37.2\% . Finally, removing the off-policy importance-sampling ratio reduces performance to 35.3 % 35.3\% , confirming the importance of explicitly accounting for the remaining behavior-policy mismatch during optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析 PICO 各个组成部分的贡献。 如表 3 所示，结果突出了保持引导轨迹与学生策略之间兼容性的重要性。 在没有联合解码的情况下直接从教师采样会引入最大的行为失配，并产生最差的消融结果，使平均分数从 37.2 % 37.2\% 降至 33.8 % 33.8\% 。 固定 k k 的变体进一步揭示了教师指导与学生兼容性之间的权衡。 增大 k k 会保留更多与学生兼容的 token，但会削弱教师指导的选择性，可能降低 rollout 准确率。 只要候选集保持足够准确，增大 k k 就能改进学习效果，从 k = 5 k=5 到 k = 10 k=10 的提升即为证据。 然而，进一步将 k k 增大到 20 20 会削弱教师指导并轻微降低性能，因此 k = 10 k=10 是最佳的固定设置。 相比之下，我们的动态 top- k k 策略根据保留的学生概率质量在每个解码步骤调整候选集，实现了更好的平衡，并取得了 37.2 % 37.2\% 的最高平均分数。 最后，移除非策略（off-policy）重要性采样比率会将性能降低到 35.3 % 35.3\% ，这证实在优化过程中显式考虑剩余的行为策略失配非常重要。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies show that on-policy optimization is fundamentally bounded by the current policy’s exploration capacity, often causing learning to stall on challenging problems ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . To overcome this exploration bottleneck, a growing line of work incorporates off-policy expert trajectories into RLVR training ( Dong et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2025a ) . LUFFY ( Yan et al., 2025 ) combines expert demonstrations with on-policy rollouts through mixed-policy optimization, while ReLIFT ( Ma et al., 2026 ) interleaves reinforcement learning with supervised fine-tuning on high-quality solutions to challenging problems. SRFT and Chord further unifies supervised learning from expert demonstrations and reinforcement learning from self-generated rollouts within a single training stage ( Fu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . However, because expert trajectories may lie in low-probability regions under the current student policy, directly optimizing on them can induce substantial distribution mismatch, potentially leading to excessive policy drift and unstable optimization ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Setlur et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, PICO uses expert trajectories to guide distribution-constrained joint decoding, producing successful rollouts that remain compatible with the student policy.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究表明，同策略优化从根本上受限于当前策略的探索能力，常常导致学习在具有挑战性的问题上陷入停滞（Yue et al., 2025）。 为了克服这一探索瓶颈，越来越多的研究工作将离策略的专家轨迹引入 RLVR 训练中（Dong et al., 2026b；Liu et al., 2025a）。 LUFFY（Yan et al., 2025）通过混合策略优化将专家演示与同策略采样相结合，而 ReLIFT（Ma et al., 2026）则将强化学习与针对难题的高质量解的监督微调交替进行。 SRFT 和 Chord 进一步将从专家演示中进行的监督学习与从自采样轨迹中进行的强化学习统一到单一训练阶段中（Fu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 然而，由于专家轨迹可能位于当前学生策略的低概率区域，直接在其上进行优化会引起显著的分布失配，可能导致策略过度漂移和优化不稳定（Agrawal et al., 2026；Setlur et al., 2026；Zheng et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2026）。 相比之下，PICO 利用专家轨迹来引导分布受限的联合解码，生成与学生策略保持兼容的成功采样轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Rather than directly optimizing on off-policy demonstrations, another line of work uses expert information to guide rollout generation ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Prefix-RFT ( Huang et al., 2026 ) conditions rollouts on prefixes sampled from expert demonstrations, while BREAD and StepHint use expert-derived prefixes or intermediate hints to steer exploration toward promising reasoning states ( Zhang et al., 2026d ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . OC-GRPO ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) further applies importance sampling ratio to account for the mismatch between guided rollouts and the original unguided policy. Although these methods facilitate successful exploration, injecting guidance into the rollout context may teach the student to continue from expert-induced states without learning how to reach those states independently from the original prompt ( Qu et al., 2026 ; Ross et al., 2011 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . A related line of work combines or contrasts the token distributions of models with different capabilities to steer generation toward higher-quality outputs ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Dekoninck et al., 2024 ) . The effectiveness of these methods motivates us to incorporate teacher guidance at the token level. Accordingly, PICO employs distribution-constrained joint decoding to construct policy-compatible trajectories.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced PICO , a policy-compatible reinforcement learning framework for overcoming the exploration bottleneck of RLVR on challenging problems. PICO leverages expert data to generate verified trajectories while controlling their deviation from the student policy, and selectively incorporates these trajectories into all-failure groups to restore informative learning signals. Extensive experiments across mathematical reasoning, general reasoning, and agentic tasks demonstrate that PICO consistently outperforms standard RLVR and representative expert-guided baselines across different model scales, without requiring teacher guidance at inference time. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component. Overall, our results highlight policy compatibility as a key principle for effectively incorporating expert knowledge into RLVR, providing a practical approach to improving models beyond the limits of unaided on-policy exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 PICO，一个策略兼容的强化学习框架，用于克服 RLVR 在高难度问题上的探索瓶颈。 PICO 利用专家数据生成经验证的轨迹，同时控制这些轨迹与学生策略的偏差，并有选择地将这些轨迹纳入全失败组中，以恢复有信息量的学习信号。 在数学推理、通用推理和智能体任务上的大量实验表明，PICO 在不同模型规模下始终优于标准 RLVR 和具有代表性的专家引导基线，且在推理时无需教师指导。 消融实验进一步验证了每个组件的有效性。 总体而言，我们的结果凸显了策略兼容性作为将专家知识有效融入 RLVR 的关键原则，为突破无辅助在线策略探索的极限、改进模型提供了一种实用的方法。

paragraphs.en: Question Rescue through Joint Decoding. Figure 4 directly illustrates how joint decoding recovers learning signals from questions that are entirely unsolved by student self-sampling. Across training, joint decoding rescues approximately 80 % 80\% and 76 % 76\% of these questions for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on mathematical reasoning tasks, respectively, substantially reducing the number of all-incorrect groups. It also rescues 36 % 36\% of the failed questions on ALFWorld, despite the greater difficulty of long-horizon interaction. These results confirm that joint decoding enables the policy to obtain successful trajectories on problems beyond the reach of its current self-exploration, thereby converting otherwise uninformative groups into effective training signals.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate mathematical reasoning on AIME 2025, AIME 2026, HMMT 2026, and MATH500. AIME 2025 and AIME 2026 each contain 30 problems drawn from the corresponding AIME I and AIME II competitions. These problems require exact numerical answers and cover algebra, geometry, combinatorics, and number theory. HMMT 2026 contains 33 problems from the February 2026 Harvard–MIT Mathematics Tournament and provides a complementary evaluation of advanced competition-level mathematical reasoning. MATH-500 is a widely used subset of the MATH test set comprising 500 problems across seven mathematical subjects and a range of difficulty levels. Compared with the recent competition benchmarks, MATH-500 provides broader coverage of mathematical topics and evaluates performance on a larger and more diverse problem set. Since our reasoning models are trained on DAPO-Math-17K, we treat these three competition-mathematics benchmarks as in-domain evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 AIME 2025、AIME 2026、HMMT 2026 和 MATH500 上评估数学推理能力。 AIME 2025 和 AIME 2026 各包含 30 道题，题目选自对应的 AIME I 和 AIME II 竞赛。 这些题目要求给出精确的数值答案，涵盖代数、几何、组合数学和数论。 HMMT 2026 包含 33 道题，来自 2026 年 2 月的哈佛—麻省理工数学锦标赛，为高难度竞赛级数学推理提供了补充评估。 MATH-500 是 MATH 测试集的一个广泛使用的子集，包含 500 道题，覆盖七个数学科目和多种难度级别。 与近期的竞赛基准相比，MATH-500 对数学主题的覆盖面更广，可在更大、更多样化的题目集上评估性能。 由于我们的推理模型在 DAPO-Math-17K 上训练，我们将这三个竞赛数学基准视为域内评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate cross-domain generalization on GPQA-Diamond and Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE). GPQA-Diamond contains 198 expert-written, graduate-level multiple-choice questions, primarily covering physics, chemistry, and biology. The full HLE benchmark comprises 2,500 expert-level questions spanning more than 100 academic and professional subjects. We use its text-only subset, which contains 500 questions and excludes items that require multimodal inputs. These benchmarks differ substantially from the mathematics-focused training distribution and therefore assess whether the reasoning capabilities acquired during training transfer to previously unseen domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 GPQA-Diamond 和 Humanity’s Last Exam（HLE）上评估跨领域泛化能力。 GPQA-Diamond 包含 198 道由专家编写的研究生级多项选择题，主要涵盖物理、化学和生物学。 完整的 HLE 基准包含 2,500 道专家级问题，涵盖 100 多个学术和专业学科。 我们使用其纯文本子集，该子集包含 500 道问题，并排除了需要多模态输入的题目。 这些基准与以数学为核心的训练分布差异很大，因此可以评估训练中获得的推理能力能否迁移到之前未见过的领域。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate agentic reasoning on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld using Qwen3-4B-Instruct. ALFWorld is a text-based interactive benchmark in which an agent must complete household tasks by interpreting observations and executing sequences of admissible actions. Following the standard evaluation protocol, we evaluate on 140 task instances from the valid-seen split and 134 task instances from the valid-unseen split. ScienceWorld is an interactive text environment centered on elementary-science reasoning. It comprises 30 task types across 10 scientific topics, instantiated into 1,819 task variations. These tasks require the agent to explore the environment, manipulate objects, and complete multi-step scientific procedures. For both benchmarks, each rollout corresponds to a complete interaction episode, and we use the environment-provided task-completion signal to determine success.

paragraphs.en: we present the prompts used for mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks. The student prompt contains only the original task information and the interaction context available under the target policy. The teacher receives the same task context together with privileged guidance derived from off-policy data. For mathematical reasoning, this guidance is an expert solution associated with the training problem. For ALFWorld, it is a known-correct expert trajectory, which the teacher aligns with the current observation and action history to identify a suitable next action. The off-policy data is never included in the student’s prompt or generated context. Instead, the teacher uses it only to produce token-level predictions during joint decoding, while the student distribution determines the relative sampling probabilities over the retained candidate tokens. This design incorporates information from successful off-policy solutions without training the student directly on their full trajectories or exposing privileged information at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了用于数学推理和智能体任务的提示词。 学生提示词仅包含原始任务信息以及在目标策略下可获得的交互上下文。 教师则接收相同的任务上下文，以及从离策略数据中导出的特权指导信息。 在数学推理中，该指导信息是与训练题目相关联的专家解答。 在 ALFWorld 中，它是一条已知正确的专家轨迹，教师将其与当前的观察和动作历史对齐，以确定合适的下一步动作。 离策略数据绝不会出现在学生的提示词或其生成的上下文中。 相反，教师仅在联合解码时利用它来生成词元级预测，而学生分布决定被保留候选词元的相对采样概率。 这一设计融入了来自成功离策略解答的信息，同时无需直接在完整轨迹上训练学生，也不会在推理时暴露特权信息。
